key.name: debug
key.description: Whether to print verbose debug messages to the system log.

key.name: indicator-enabled
key.description: Whether to show the language indicator button in the GNOME Shell top panel.

key.name: hide-system-indicator
key.description: Whether to hide the default GNOME Shell keyboard indicator to prevent duplicates.

key.name: indicator-format
key.summary: Format of the layout text in the panel
key.description: Display format for the current layout code: 'short' (uppercase code, e.g. EN, RU), 'lowercase' (en, ru), 'full' (displayName, e.g. English (US), Russian).

key.name: scroll-switch
key.description: Whether scrolling the mouse wheel over the indicator switches to next/previous layout.

key.name: memory-mode
key.description: Mode of remembering layouts: 'off' (disabled), 'per-app' (per application), 'per-window' (per individual window).

key.name: default-layout-mode
key.description: Action for newly focused windows without prior history: 'keep' (preserve active layout), 'first' (reset to first configured layout).

key.name: memory-excluded-apps
key.summary: List of applications excluded from layout memory
key.description: Array of application IDs or WM_CLASS values that should be ignored by the memory manager.

key.name: show-osd
key.summary: Show OSD pop-up on layout switch
key.description: Display a brief centered on-screen display when switching input sources.

key.name: osd-duration-ms
key.description: How long the OSD pop-up stays visible before fading out.

key.name: osd-show-on-auto-switch
key.summary: Show OSD on automatic window layout restore
key.description: Whether to show OSD notification when layout is restored automatically for a window.

key.name: hotkey-next
key.description: Keybinding to activate the next configured input source cyclically.

key.name: hotkey-previous
key.description: Keybinding to activate the previous configured input source cyclically.

key.name: hotkey-switch-1
key.description: Keybinding to directly activate the 1st configured layout (index 0).

key.name: hotkey-switch-2
key.description: Keybinding to directly activate the 2nd configured layout (index 1).

key.name: hotkey-switch-3
key.description: Keybinding to directly activate the 3rd configured layout (index 2).

key.name: hotkey-switch-4
key.description: Keybinding to directly activate the 4th configured layout (index 3).

key.name: backup-system-shortcuts
key.summary: Backup map of freed system shortcuts
key.description: JSON-encoded dictionary of original system keybindings modified by user action.

key.name: backup-system-switch-keys
key.description: Saved original values of switch-input-source for rollback upon extension disable.

key.name: backup-system-switch-backward-keys
key.description: Saved original values of switch-input-source-backward for rollback upon extension disable.

key.name: convert-text-enabled
key.description: Whether to enable in-memory keyboard buffer to convert text typed in the wrong layout (e.g. ghbdtn -> привет).

key.name: convert-double-shift
key.summary: Trigger conversion on double Left Shift
key.description: Convert the last typed word when Left Shift is pressed twice in quick succession.

key.name: convert-hotkey
key.summary: Shortcut to convert last typed word
key.description: Keybinding to trigger layout conversion of the most recently typed word.
